author: NingMeng123

server_source.behavior: Reads professions default false, then forcibly assigns false; do not enable a profession gate merely because Skill.ENCHANTING exists.

conditional_client_gate.behavior: When world skills flag is enabled, client prevents clicks without Skill.ENCHANTING. ContainerEnchantment itself has no skill test.

candidate_source.behavior: Iterates every non-null aau entry; creative-tab visibility does not filter table selection. Books bypass canEnchantItem while ordinary items must pass.

random_algorithm_path.world_random_helper: aaw.a(Random,ItemStack,energy) -> enchantability compression -> aaw.b; unlike the table, the helper attaches ALL returned enchantments even to a book.

input_and_activation.ordinary_item: Maximum stack size must equal 1, item must be damageable, enchantability positive, and actual ench tag absent.
input_and_activation.table_opening: Block directly above table must be air or passable (non-solid and non-liquid).

bookshelves.type: minecraft:bookshelf only; no arbitrary enchantment-power tag in R196
bookshelves.distance: perimeter of a 5x5 square, excluding four corners: 12 positions each layer; max 24
bookshelves.paths: Each cardinal near cell (0,+/-1) or (+/-1,0) permits corresponding center outer shelf. Corner-adjacent outer shelves are permitted if the associated near diagonal is passable AND at least one adjacent cardinal near cell is passable. A shelf counts once even if two routes are open.
bookshelves.upper_layer_gate: dy=1 evaluated only when center above table (0,1,0) is passable. Same-layer path cells determine each layer independently.
bookshelves.passable_predicate: Air OR non-solid block excluding liquids; unavailable chunk is false. Do not automatically use modern enchantment_power_transmitter tag without documenting adaptation.

offered_energy.compress_formula: Let E=item enchantability, P=raw power. E<1 => 0; P<=E => P; else Math.round(E + 0.5*min(P-E,E) + 0.25*min(max(P-2E,0),E)). Values above 3E contribute nothing.
offered_energy.random_rng: java.util.Random with float arithmetic and Java Math.round semantics
offered_energy.no_double_compression: ContainerEnchantment invokes b(Random,stack,offeredEnergy) directly; only mob/loot-style a(Random,stack,energy) compresses before selection.
offered_energy.recalculation: Enchantable input inventory changes regenerate offered values and cosmetic runic seed. No modern persistent three-option preview/clue contract exists in R196.

experience_payment.eligibility: Offered energy >0 AND input non-null AND (total experience bJ >= cost OR creative).
experience_payment.deduction: Server calls player.s(-cost) only on a non-null generated enchantment list, or on fixed water/apple conversion. No result => no payment.
experience_payment.ui_number: Shows experience point cost, not enchantment energy or player level.
experience_payment.creative_historical_behavior: Creative bypasses eligibility but still calls signed XP deduction; total lower bound -800. Retaining modern creative free enchanting would be an explicit adaptation.
experience_payment.modern_safe_transaction_requirement: Actual final deduction must use the existing canonical total-points system, preserve quality/components, reject insufficient points server side, and not publish output if a mod cancels payment.
experience_payment.score: Source uf.addExperience only adds score on positive gains; enchanting reduces canonical XP points without subtracting accumulated score.

random_selection.candidate_levels: For each allowed enchantment choose the highest level with minimumEnergy(level)<=remaining. There is no maximum-energy window exclusion.
random_selection.single_level_special_case: Non-levelled enchantments are level 1 in output but the minimum cost uses synthetic level 3: max(difficulty-10,0)+2*difficulty+1.
random_selection.weighted_item: Each candidate enchantment appears once, weighted by rarity regardless of chosen level.
random_selection.compatibility: Before each draw remove every candidate rejected by ANY already-selected enchantment compatibility method; self duplicates are incompatible.
random_selection.first_two_level_randomization: For selected index 0 or 1, when candidate count>1, enchantment has multiple levels, and nextInt(2)==0, replace highest permitted level L with nextInt(L)+1.
random_selection.continuation: Continue only if remaining>=5 and numberSelected<=2; maximum 3 selected enchantments.
random_selection.ordering: After selection, random shuffle by sampling unused indices; outputs have no fixed enchantment order.
random_selection.book_table_result: Table chooses nextInt(resultList.size()) and attaches only that single entry to an enchanted book. A book is NOT weighted again by rarity at this final step.
random_selection.no_vanilla_halving: R196 does not use modern modified enchantability random additions or repeated level-halving/50-chance additional enchantment rules.

enchanted_book_storage.storage: StoredEnchantments entries; same ID replaces only if incoming level is greater, never adds levels or upgrades equal-level duplicates.
enchanted_book_storage.generated_book_from_random_loot: xo random loot chooses uniformly from the full aau.c registered list, then uniformly level 1..maxLevel. That is a different path from table rarity weighting.

anvil_transfer.eligibility: First stack must satisfy isEnchantable AND not have actual enchantments; second must be enchanted book with non-null StoredEnchantments and at least one valid enchantment for first item.
anvil_transfer.already_enchanted_target: Rejected; cannot add, upgrade, or merge enchantments on an already enchanted item by book.
anvil_transfer.book_plus_book: Rejected: enchanted book is not an enchantable normal book.
anvil_transfer.same_item_merge: Second enchanted equipment is rejected as a repair combination; first may retain its enchantments while combining with unenchanted damaged donor.
anvil_transfer.transfer: Copy first item; for each book enchantment valid on target, apply min(maxLevel,max(existingLevel,incomingLevel)) (equal-level branch increments, but normal entry requires target unenchanted so equal nonzero levels are unreachable).
anvil_transfer.conflicts: Transfer loop does not call compatibility! A deliberately supplied multi-enchantment conflicting book transfers every entry valid for the target. Ordinary table books contain only one entry. Preserve modern compatibility rules only as an explicit modern adaptation.
anvil_transfer.invalid_entries: Skipped; consume the whole book after taking output if at least one valid entry exists.
anvil_transfer.book_count_consumed: Entire second slot emptied (normally max stack 1).
anvil_transfer.metal_capacity_gate: Material capacity checks are only in the repair path, not book transfer.
anvil_transfer.disenchanting: Actual enchanted item+bottle of disenchanting removes enchant tags, consumes bottle, no XP and no wear; already implemented by UtilityDisenchanting.

current_implementation_gaps.finding: Only replaces modern cost calculation for emerald table. Normal diamond table, modern bookshelf scan, random enchantment selection, player-level payment, lapis, modern preview and book multi-selection remain modern.
Power/compression/formula implemented and unit tested, but no actual 24-shelf source scan, source book enchantability 30, source payment/selection.
Source repair/disenchant plans implemented; any StoredEnchantments second item returns null and falls through to modern anvil behavior.
Zero XP/no wear path implemented only for source repair/disenchant; modern enchanting cost and book upgrades still active.
Canonical point totals and extended level formula available; enchanting must spend points via canonical API without multiplying/removing player levels.

modern_adaptation_decisions_required: R196 has no lapis slot/cost. Keep visible modern lapis slot with zero use, remove slot with a custom screen, or retain lapis as explicit modern cost; do not claim retained lapis is R196.

Retain all modern enchantment types per overall project plan, but define their minimum-energy/difficulty and treasure access explicitly. R196 rarity categories are weights100/25/5/1; do not silently copy modern1/2/5/10 weights.
Modern compatibility may be retained for post-1.6.4 enchantments; distinguish it from source table conflicts and source book-transfer lack of conflict validation.
Choose and document modern creative zero-cost behavior instead of historical XP deduction if desired.
Modern screen displays levels/lapis and clues by default; source displays points and runic phrases. A custom screen or matching tooltip must prevent presenting wrong level cost.
Modern power transmitter tags and fractional bookshelf bonuses have no R196 equivalent; document mapping for additional mods instead of assuming exact equivalence.
Modern Java registry iteration differs from old HashMap<Integer,abb>; preserve probabilities and invariants, not same seed producing identical enchantment order.

implementation.author: NingMeng123
implementation.client: EnchantmentScreenMixin; shared mode DataSlot index10; modern book animation retained

source_material_enchantability.armor: MiteArmorContent audited source definition, including retained native armor IDs

implementation.tests: R196EnchantmentTableGameTests15 + R196ExperienceBottleGameTests2; updated FunctionalBlockGameTests; full1156GameTests passed.

modern_adaptations.lapis: User override (2026-10-15): both table tiers require and consume native 1/2/3 lapis for choices0/1/2 in survival. Creative bypasses materials and XP. This deliberately differs from R196 no-lapis source behavior.
modern_adaptations.screen: Native panel/book animation/lapis slot and native choice icons retained. Buttons show exact XP point cost and require both points and lapis; hover contains exactly energy/current XP/required XP, including creative.
modern_adaptations.creative: Source result selection still applies but no XP or material charge.
modern_adaptations.passable: Modern state.blocksMotion and empty fluid state map source non-solid, non-liquid predicate.
modern_adaptations.modern_equipment: Crossbow,trident,mace,shield,elytra excluded from source equipment classifier; native table and merge paths retained.
modern_adaptations.modern_enchantments: Source table/general source loot pools contain only the38 registered source definitions. Explicit modern-only book pools retain vanilla selection; native enchant_randomly, trades and pre-enchanted loot remain available. Pure modern book transfers use native anvil fees/upgrades, including on source-enchanted equipment.
modern_adaptations.book_merging: User bug-fix override (2026-10-17): source books may add compatible enchantments to already-enchanted source equipment, retaining all existing entries. Equal levels upgrade by one, unequal levels use the higher level, capped at the source/native maximum. Conflicts and no-change results are rejected. Source book transfers still cost no XP or anvil wear; source book-book merges remain rejected. Four native leather armor pieces additionally accept Unbreaking books I-V; the historical table/catalogue eligibility is unchanged.
modern_adaptations.mixed_books: If source entry does not apply to target but a modern entry does, preserve native modern cost. Every added entry must satisfy compatibility against retained and newly added entries; unrelated unsupported entries are ignored.
modern_adaptations.seed: R196 algorithm probabilities and constraints retained; registry/collection iteration differs, so no old seed-result identity promised.
modern_adaptations.actual_loot_book_pool: Default native enchant_randomly and villager TRADEABLE pools currently append17MITE entries to the original modern pool (uniform mixed pool; can include modern Infinity). They are explicitly modern acquisition routes, not an exact38-only R196 structure/trade book pool. Table and general source level-based pools strictly use38registered source definitions and never include Infinity.
modern_adaptations.book_entrypoint_distinction: Table vm selects one entry from aaw.b; world helper aaw.a adds all up-to3 entries even to a normal book. Real R196 structure books (afp:91,agi:212,etc) call xo.b / xo.a and uniformly choose1enchantment,uniform level. R196 villagers ub:325-330 also choose1, while actual aaw.a callers og:974 and ub:344 provide equipment, not books. Modern level-based books retain the general helper behavior as an adaptation.

implementation.experience_bottle: ExperienceBottleExperienceMixin changes only native ExperienceOrb.award amount to200; native NeoForge ProjectileImpactEvent cancellation, splash,orb split/merge,discard retained.
implementation.offer_refresh: Lapis changes do not reroll energy/seed for the same input and bookshelf/table access state. Server payment revalidates input, energy and lapis contents after cancellable XP approval, before either cost is committed.
